senses.definition: To go with or attend as a companion or associate; to keep company with; to go along with.
senses.example: Geoffrey accompanied the group on their pilgrimage.
synonyms: attend
escort
go with

senses.example: He was thinking; but the glory of the song, the swell from the great organ, the clustered lights, […], the height and vastness of this noble fane, its antiquity and its strength—all these things seemed to have their part as causes of the thrilling emotion that accompanied his thoughts.
synonyms: We accompany those with whom we go as companions. The word imports an equality of station.
We attend those whom we wait upon
follow. The word conveys an idea of subordination.
A gentleman accompanies a friend to some public place
he attends
escorts a lady
We escort those whom we attend with a view to guard and protect
